content.text:
I submitted index 47 (Bi 0.33, Cu 0.21, V 0.46) as the best composition. It had the highest photocurrent of the three I measured, but that is only 3 of the 188 candidates, so the library's true best could well be somewhere I didn't test.

| Index | Bi / Cu / V | Photocurrent |
|---|---|---|
| **47** | 0.33 / 0.21 / 0.46 | **65.7 µA** |
| 24 | 0.09 / 0.47 / 0.45 | 49.6 µA |
| 38 | 0.25 / 0.21 / 0.54 | 20.5 µA |

- **How I chose the samples:** I measured two different regions first. Index 24 is mostly copper vanadate, and index 47 is close to bismuth vanadate (BiVO4) with some Cu.
- **Last measurement:** index 47 did better, so I spent the last one on index 38, with a bit less Cu and more V. That guess was wrong: it gave less than a third of index 47's current. So adding V at the expense of Bi seems to hurt here.
- **Unused tools:** I did not use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so I have no phase identification for these films. I also didn't follow the Gaussian-process model's suggestion (index 22), because it predicted less current than index 47 had already given.
